name: Schokland and Surroundings
description: Schokland is a long, low ridge in the Noordoostpolder, once an island in the Zuiderzee. Its people battled rising waters for centuries until the last were evacuated in 1859. After the 1940s land reclamation, the old island became a gentle rise in farmland. Visitors can still trace its old harbour walls and find traces of settlement reaching back to prehistoric times.
